messages:
sam: Heads-up: planning blue/green flip for router v3 tonight 22:00 UTC. We'll target 10% initially for a small cohort (beta users) and shadow traffic to v3 for 30m. Quiet window 22:00-22:40.
tasha: Copy. Can we do cookie-affinity check and a quick L7 header parity test before ramp?
deploy-bot: Blue/green orchestration scheduled. Steps: shadow 100% for 30m, cohort route 10% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% at +10m,+20m,+30m,+35m. Auto-rollback: enabled. Probes: /health, /api/status, trace-sample=1%.
sre-lee: Rollback gates: sustained 5xx > 0.3% over baseline for 3m OR p50 tail shift > 2x baseline for 5m OR failure of parity checks (header mismatch) in >0.5% of traces. Also ensure no auth token errors.
infra-joel: Preflight: warmed green pool B with full image, warmed LB connections, set drain_timeout=90s. I also enabled header parity probe on canary-router.
product-ana: I'll notify support and add a blurb to release notes: "Blue/green: v3 rollout with shadowing; support watchlist enabled."
tasha: Running parity probe now: comparing X-Request-ID and X-Trace headers across blue vs green.

deploy-bot: Parity probe results at 21:56 UTC: header parity 99.6% match, small discrepancy in X-Exp-Feature header (0.4%). Safe to continue.
sam: Starting shadowing now — all user traffic duplicated to v3 but not served as primary. Watch for side effects.
sre-lee: Shadow logs look clean. No auth flaps. p95 baseline 120ms, current p95 for green 125ms. Acceptable.
infra-joel: Kicking cohort 10% at 22:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: 10% cohort active. Probing.
tasha: Seeing a small uptick in 502s in one region (us-west). 502s from edge-to-green connection, ~0.15% at 10% step. Will dig into logs.
sre-lee: 0.15% is within gate, but trend is upward. Correlate with a specific hostgroup?

infra-joel: Isolating hostgroup g-west-3: there's increased connection reset rate. I'll remove g-west-3 from pool and drain it. Rolling back that host should not require full rollback.
sam: Good call. Remove from load balancing ring and keep cohort at 10%.

deploy-bot: g-west-3 removed, drain started. 10% cohort unchanged.
tasha: After removal, 502 rate fell back to 0.04%. Parity still 99.5%.
sre-lee: Keeping eyes. Proceed to 25% in +10m if rates hold.

deploy-bot: Advancing to 25% cohort at +10m.
infra-joel: 25% in. Observability: slight p95 uptick to 135ms in eu region, likely cold caches. Will pre-warm caches for those nodes.

product-ana: Support alerted, no user-facing errors reported.

sre-lee: At 25% the 5xx rate jump to 0.6% in eu-west for 4m. This hits auto-rollback gate (threshold 0.3% for 3m).
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback triggered by metric alert: 5xx > threshold. Initiating rollback now: shifting traffic back to blue and draining green pool. Notifying #deploy-alerts.
sam: Confirmed rollback. Set v3 traffic to 0%. Save logs and traces for postmortem.

infra-joel: Rollback complete. All traffic on blue. Green pool drained.
tasha: Parity probe after rollback: irrelevant, but I'm collecting failed traces.

sre-lee: Opening incident tracker and assigning postmortem. Likely causes: cache warmup differences + a bad config on green edge nodes. We'll triage.

product-ana: I'll update release notes to mark attempt as aborted and link incident.
sam: Thanks team. New action items: repro in staging for eu cache warmup, audit edge config deploy for green pool, tighten preflight parity threshold to 99.9%.

infra-joel: I'll pin checklist updates to the runbook and add a step to exclude hostgroups with recent infra changes.
sre-lee: Scheduling a follow-up async postmortem doc. Please drop traces and timeline there.

deploy-bot: Rollback documented. You can re-schedule a fresh attempt after infra fixes.

sam: Closing thread for now. We'll reconvene after infra fixes and a staged re-run. :white_check_mark:
_meta: synthetic slack thread generated for dataset
